title: Optional verifier state update
statement: Let $N$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet and $st$ a verifier state. On no cell value, the update retains the first flag, stored head state, and both families of tape-index values; it sets the next-to-last flag to false and retains the last flag. On a supplied cell value, it applies the verifier state update defined by that value.
